summary: This is a configuration file that defines two local AI models running through Ollama, a local AI provider. The first model is a larger, faster assistant used for chat and editing tasks, while the second is a smaller, specialized coding model used for autocomplete suggestions. Both models connect to the same local Ollama server.

explanations.3: The schema version indicates which format version this config file follows, allowing the system to know how to parse it correctly.
explanations.6: Provider is the service that runs the AI model — in this case, Ollama, which runs models locally on your machine rather than sending requests to the cloud.
explanations.8: The apiBase is the network address where the Ollama server is listening; 127.0.0.1 means localhost (your own computer) and 11434 is the port number it uses.
explanations.9: Roles define what tasks this model is available for — this model can handle both chat conversations and text editing operations.
